note: Render-leak ratchet: per-marker (files, occurrences) of aozora notation control markers (《…》 / ｜ / ［＃…］) surviving into VISIBLE rendered HTML. Leaks may only SHRINK — any rise fails the gate; ratchet down on improvement with `--update`. Run `xtask corpus render-audit` to find WHICH document regressed. The 2026-07-12 drop (ruby 8710→1588, bar 1904→1604, directive 3103→1472) is the F21 fix (ADR-0030): a stray `［` crossing a line break is now line-scoped, so it no longer sinks the rest of the document to plain. The residual is a documented long tail (2026-07-03, campaign #399): mixed kanji+gaiji ruby base (E2), ヵ/ヶ ateji declines, symbol/digit/Cyrillic/kanbun bases, and authorial 《…》 with no ruby base (a correct literal, not a leak) — irreducible or tracked follow-ups.
